line_items.work_text: Immediate Restoration of Road from NH-31 at Targhat to Ghageralga under SDRF (FDR)
Immediate Restoration of approaches of RCC Br. No.1/1 on Charaldanga Bridge approach road under SDRF for the year 2013-14
Immediate Restoration to Panchughat to Alirghat at Balurchar (Providing bamboo palasiding and sand filled bag dumping) under SDRF for the year 2016-17
Immediate Restoration of Udami Salkocha road for 2013-14 under SDRF

narrative: SEC accorded approval for release of fund amounting to Rs. 1,85,06,726/- against 48 nos of SDRF Proposals for Temporary Restoration works executed in Lakhimpur district by the PWD Roads Department during 2017-18 on an urgent basis to restore communication during flood emergency in Lakhimpur District before issuance of the Administrative Approval.
